blends.name: PFP Pack - Blend 3 - Holders of 5 or more of Dinger/AK raffle (10)
blends.desc:
This blend is whitelisted for Holders of 5 or more of Dinger/AK raffle.

**Required ingredients for blending:**
* Any 3 x Original Rarity - Series 1 NFTs
* Any 2 x Nexus Rarity - Series 1 NFTs
* Any 2 x First Degree Rarity - Series 1 NFTs

Maximum claim: 1 pack

Packs have random mints between 167 and 176.
